wardenRiddle: The Weave broke when truth saw madness, sight became change, and the final hand chose protection over power.

failureHints.balance_stabilizer: The weave lacks stability — it needs an anchor.
failureHints.balance_destructive: Destructive forces have no place here. Choose protection over power.
failureHints.flow_broken: The flow of magic is disrupted. The current does not run true.
failureHints.forbidden_adjacency: Death and destruction strain against each other. They must not touch.
failureHints.anchor_invalid: The outer ring must hold truth — only sight can begin the weave.
failureHints.opposing_mirror_13: The first and third rings echo each other. Symmetry breeds instability.
failureHints.opposing_mirror_24: The second and fourth rings mirror too closely.
failureHints.channel_not_unified: The channel was not unified. All must commit together.
